name: Can I temporarily patch storm-damaged siding myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I temporarily patch storm-damaged siding myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While temporary patches can offer immediate, short-term protection, it's generally not recommended as a long-term solution. DIY patches might prevent some water intrusion but often lack the proper seals and durability of professional repairs, potentially leading to hidden moisture problems or further damage. For storm damage, which can sometimes affect the underlying structure, a professional assessment ensures that all issues are identified and properly addressed. For lasting results and to maintain your home's integrity, professional repair is always the safest approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Temporary DIY patches offer short-term protection but are not recommended as a long-term solution due to potential hidden damage and lack of durability.
